prior_fit: Prior source TRAIN only, eligible with valid T3/L2; per-level median normalized along-segment fraction and lateral residual; never uses TUM values for fitting
reference_calibration: Affine vertical span and horizontal residual around the T3-L2 line, using predicted endpoints and supplied oracle endpoints; projection on unchanged posterior surface
metric: Remaining valid target X/Z mean per case, median over initialization seeds, case-equal average; all valid errors retained when surface misses
case_exclusions: Missing T3/L2 input references data QA only; all original17 in manifest and missing counts reported
purpose: Test whether sparse typed anatomy resolves source/FOV ambiguity better than surface-only predictions, as an engineering baseline; not a new architecture contribution, not clinical accuracy
comparison: No-reference and reference-assisted use identical held-out levels and source input for each case
scope: CT derived geometry and anatomy proxies, not prone RGBD, no physicians substituted
